answer: Nonce-Bound Answer Registry. Each identity must submit a fresh answer to a challenge derived from a secret willow-seeded value, so any copied response is rejected at verification. The registry stores a crystal hash of the answer plus the agent's live state snapshot. Enforcement: answers are single-use and expire in one epoch; replay fails the cipher check against the agent's evolving key. An attacker pays one full recomputation and fresh state proof per identity per epoch, so N sybils cost N live compute cycles, not N registrations.
